cases.text: My 7-year-old argues when screen time ends. What can I try this evening?
میرا سات سال کا بچہ اسکرین کا وقت ختم ہونے پر بحث کرتا ہے۔ آج شام میں کیا کر سکتا ہوں؟
My child is unconscious right now and is not responding to me.

reply.heading: Support for your situation
reply.message: I am concerned about this immediate danger. Contact local emergency services now. If safe, ask a trusted person nearby to stay with you and help.
